task: Open /home/user/Documents/tower.ply in CloudCompare. It is an ASCII PLY with 2000 points distributed in a vertical column (X, Y in -1..1, Z in 0..10). Extract a thin horizontal slice: keep only points with Z in the interval [4.5, 5.5]. Export the resulting slice cloud as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/tower_slice.ply. The output must have at least 50 points and all points' Z coordinates must lie within [4.5, 5.5].

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare cloud sf-filter-z --min Z_MIN --max Z_MAX -o output.ply
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'cloud sf-filter-z' command to filter points by Z coordinate range, which implements cross-section slicing.
